It looked like a good idea, but wait until I tell you what happened. <break time="0.8s" /> Bill Driscoll and I were down South in Alabama when this kidnapping idea came to us. <break time="0.8s" /> We had about six hundred dollars, but we needed two thousand more for a dishonest land plan. <break time="0.8s" /> In Summit, a town as flat as a pancake, we chose the only son of a rich man named Ebenezer Dorset. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy was ten years old, with lots of freckles and bright red hair. <break time="0.8s" /> About two miles from Summit, there was a small mountain covered with thick cedar trees. <break time="0.8s" /> On the far side of the mountain was a cave, and we stored our food there. <break time="0.8s" /> One evening we drove a buggy past old Dorsets house and found the boy throwing stones at a kitten. <break time="0.8s" /> When Bill offered him candy and a nice ride, the boy hit him in the eye with a brick. <break time="0.8s" /> That will cost the old man an extra five hundred dollars, said Bill, climbing over the wheel. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy fought like a little bear, but at last we got him into the buggy and drove away.

그건 좋은 생각처럼 보였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 내가 말해 줄 때까지 기다려 보라. <break time="0.8s" /> 무슨 일이 있었는지. <break time="0.8s" /> 빌 드리스콜과 나는. <break time="0.8s" /> 남부 앨라배마에 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그때 이 납치 계획이 우리에게 떠올랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리에게는 600달러쯤 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 2, 000달러가 더 필요했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 부정한 땅 거래 계획을 위해. <break time="0.8s" /> 서밋에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그곳은 팬케이크처럼 납작한 마을이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리는 외아들을 골랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 에버니저 도싯이라는 부자의. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 아이는 열 살이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 주근깨가 많았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 머리카락이 새빨갰다. <break time="0.8s" /> 서밋에서 2마일쯤 떨어진 곳에. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 산이 하나 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 울창한 삼나무로 덮인. <break time="0.8s" /> 산의 반대편에. <break time="0.8s" /> 동굴이 하나 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 우리는 그곳에 식량을 쌓아 두었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 어느 날 저녁. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리는 마차를 몰았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 도싯 영감의 집 앞을 지나. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그 아이를 발견했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 새끼 고양이에게 돌을 던지고 있는. <break time="0.8s" /> 빌이 아이에게 권하자. <break time="0.8s" /> 사탕과 멋진 마차 타기를. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 아이는 그의 눈을 때렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 벽돌로. <break time="0.8s" /> 이 일로 영감이 치러야 할 거야. <break time="0.8s" /> 500달러를 더. <break time="0.8s" /> 빌이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 바퀴를 넘어오면서. <break time="0.8s" /> 아이는 작은 곰처럼 싸웠다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 마침내. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리는 그를 마차에 태웠다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 떠났다.

When I came back. <break time="0.8s" /> From returning the buggy. <break time="0.8s" /> Bill was putting bandages. <break time="0.8s" /> On his scratches and bruises. <break time="0.8s" /> A fire was burning. <break time="0.8s" /> At the mouth of the cave. <break time="0.8s" /> And the boy was watching. <break time="0.8s" /> A pot of boiling coffee. <break time="0.8s" /> He pointed a stick at me. <break time="0.8s" /> And shouted. <break time="0.8s" /> Do you dare to enter. <break time="0.8s" /> The camp of Red Chief. <break time="0.8s" /> In the boys game. <break time="0.8s" /> Bill was Old Hank the Trapper. <break time="0.8s" /> And I was Snake eye the Spy. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy loved camping in the cave. <break time="0.8s" /> So much that he forgot. <break time="0.8s" /> That he was a captive himself. <break time="0.8s" /> I like this fine. <break time="0.8s" /> And I have never had so much fun. <break time="0.8s" /> In all my life he said. <break time="0.8s" /> At supper. <break time="0.8s" /> He told us that he hated school. <break time="0.8s" /> And that he had once owned. <break time="0.8s" /> A pet possum. <break time="0.8s" /> We went to bed late. <break time="0.8s" /> But the boy kept us awake. <break time="0.8s" /> For hours. <break time="0.8s" /> Jumping up at every small sound. <break time="0.8s" /> At daybreak. <break time="0.8s" /> I was awakened. <break time="0.8s" /> By a series of terrible screams. <break time="0.8s" /> From Bill. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy was sitting on Bills chest. <break time="0.8s" /> Waving the knife. <break time="0.8s" /> We used for bacon. <break time="0.8s" /> In a wild game. <break time="0.8s" /> I took the knife away. <break time="0.8s" /> But from that moment. <break time="0.8s" /> Bills spirit was broken.

When I came back from returning the buggy, Bill was putting bandages on his scratches and bruises. <break time="0.8s" /> A fire was burning at the mouth of the cave, and the boy was watching a pot of boiling coffee. <break time="0.8s" /> He pointed a stick at me and shouted, Do you dare to enter the camp of Red Chief. <break time="0.8s" /> In the boys game, Bill was Old Hank the Trapper, and I was Snake eye the Spy. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy loved camping in the cave so much that he forgot that he was a captive himself. <break time="0.8s" /> I like this fine, and I have never had so much fun in all my life, he said. <break time="0.8s" /> At supper he told us that he hated school and that he had once owned a pet possum. <break time="0.8s" /> We went to bed late, but the boy kept us awake for hours, jumping up at every small sound. <break time="0.8s" /> At daybreak I was awakened by a series of terrible screams from Bill. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy was sitting on Bills chest, waving the knife we used for bacon in a wild game. <break time="0.8s" /> I took the knife away, but from that moment Bills spirit was broken.

내가 돌아왔을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 마차를 돌려주고 나서. <break time="0.8s" /> 빌은 붕대를 붙이고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 긁힌 상처와 멍에. <break time="0.8s" /> 불이 타고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 동굴 입구에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 아이는 지켜보고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 끓고 있는 커피 주전자를. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 나에게 막대기를 겨누었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 외쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 감히 들어오느냐. <break time="0.8s" /> 붉은 추장의 진영에. <break time="0.8s" /> 아이의 놀이에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 빌은 덫 사냥꾼 행크 영감이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 나는 뱀눈 첩자였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아이는 동굴에서 야영하는 것을 좋아했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 너무 좋아해서 잊어버렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 자신이 붙잡혀 온 사람이라는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 여기 정말 좋아요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 이렇게 재미있었던 적이 없어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 평생에 그가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 저녁을 먹으며. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 학교가 싫다고 우리에게 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 한때 길렀다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 애완 주머니쥐를. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리는 늦게 잠자리에 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 아이는 우리를 잠 못 들게 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 몇 시간 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 소리마다 벌떡 일어나면서. <break time="0.8s" /> 동틀 무렵. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 잠이 깼다. <break time="0.8s" /> 연달아 터진 끔찍한 비명 때문에. <break time="0.8s" /> 빌에게서 나온. <break time="0.8s" /> 아이가 빌의 가슴 위에 앉아 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 칼을 휘두르면서. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리가 베이컨을 자를 때 쓰던. <break time="0.8s" /> 거친 놀이를 하며. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 칼을 빼앗았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그 순간부터. <break time="0.8s" /> 빌의 기는 꺾여 버렸다.

Later that morning. <break time="0.8s" /> I climbed to the top of the mountain. <break time="0.8s" /> To look for a search party. <break time="0.8s" /> But all I saw. <break time="0.8s" /> Was a quiet valley. <break time="0.8s" /> And one farmer. <break time="0.8s" /> Plowing a field with a mule. <break time="0.8s" /> Perhaps they have not noticed yet. <break time="0.8s" /> That the boy is missing. <break time="0.8s" /> I said to myself. <break time="0.8s" /> When I returned to the cave. <break time="0.8s" /> I found Bill backed against the wall. <break time="0.8s" /> Breathing hard. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy had put. <break time="0.8s" /> A hot boiled potato. <break time="0.8s" /> Down his back. <break time="0.8s" /> And now he was holding a big rock. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the boy took a sling. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of his pocket. <break time="0.8s" /> And shot a stone at Bill. <break time="0.8s" /> It hit him. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind the left ear. <break time="0.8s" /> So hard that he fell over beside the fire. <break time="0.8s" /> You will not go away. <break time="0.8s" /> And leave me here alone. <break time="0.8s" /> Will you, Sam. <break time="0.8s" /> Bill asked weakly. <break time="0.8s" /> I told the boy that I would take him straight home. <break time="0.8s" /> If he did not behave. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy quickly promised. <break time="0.8s" /> To be good. <break time="0.8s" /> As long as he could play the Black Scout. <break time="0.8s" /> That day. <break time="0.8s" /> Then Bill and I sat down. <break time="0.8s" /> To write a letter to old Dorset. <break time="0.8s" /> Asking for a ransom.

Later that morning I climbed to the top of the mountain to look for a search party. <break time="0.8s" /> But all I saw was a quiet valley and one farmer plowing a field with a mule. <break time="0.8s" /> Perhaps they have not noticed yet that the boy is missing, I said to myself. <break time="0.8s" /> When I returned to the cave, I found Bill backed against the wall, breathing hard. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy had put a hot boiled potato down his back, and now he was holding a big rock. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the boy took a sling out of his pocket and shot a stone at Bill. <break time="0.8s" /> It hit him behind the left ear so hard that he fell over beside the fire. <break time="0.8s" /> You will not go away and leave me here alone, will you, Sam, Bill asked weakly. <break time="0.8s" /> I told the boy that I would take him straight home if he did not behave. <break time="0.8s" /> The boy quickly promised to be good, as long as he could play the Black Scout that day. <break time="0.8s" /> Then Bill and I sat down to write a letter to old Dorset, asking for a ransom.

그날 오전 늦게. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 산꼭대기에 올라갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 수색대를 찾아보려고. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 내가 본 것은 전부. <break time="0.8s" /> 조용한 골짜기였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 농부 한 사람이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 노새로 밭을 갈고 있는. <break time="0.8s" /> 아마 사람들은 아직 눈치채지 못했나 보군. <break time="0.8s" /> 아이가 없어졌다는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 혼잣말을 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 동굴로 돌아왔을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 빌이 벽에 몰려 있는 것을 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 숨을 헐떡이면서. <break time="0.8s" /> 아이가 넣었었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 뜨거운 삶은 감자를. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 등 속으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 지금은 커다란 돌을 들고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러더니 아이는 새총을 꺼냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 주머니에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 빌에게 돌을 쏘았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 돌이 그를 맞혔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 왼쪽 귀 뒤를. <break time="0.8s" /> 너무 세게 맞혀서 그는 쓰러졌다 불 옆으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 가 버리지는 않겠지. <break time="0.8s" /> 나를 여기 혼자 두고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그렇지, 샘. <break time="0.8s" /> 빌이 힘없이 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 아이에게 말했다 곧장 집에 데려다주겠다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 얌전히 굴지 않으면. <break time="0.8s" /> 아이는 얼른 약속했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 착하게 굴겠다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 검은 정찰병 역할을 할 수만 있다면. <break time="0.8s" /> 그날. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고 나서 빌과 나는 자리에 앉았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 도싯 영감에게 편지를 쓰려고. <break time="0.8s" /> 몸값을 요구하면서.
